top_drivers: U.S. equities closed higher before the cutoff, with Nasdaq +1.05% and technology leadership supportive for Japan's large semiconductor/AI names.
USDJPY was around 157.99 at 06:10 JST, leaving the yen weak enough to be broadly supportive for exporters.
WTI was down about 2.17% at 05:55 JST, reducing one near-term cost/inflation headwind.
Osaka/CME Nikkei futures were around 70,180-70,185 near 06:00 JST, above the prior cash close.
counterevidence: U.S. 10-year Treasury yields remained around 5.31%, a valuation headwind for equities.
The Nikkei cash index had surged 2.40% on the prior day, so a high opening can create profit-taking and reduce same-day continuation.
The known BOJ governor appearance was scheduled for 15:35 JST, just after the 15:30 endpoint, so it is not a direct in-window event but may still affect positioning near the close.
invalidation_conditions: USDJPY strengthens materially in the yen direction before/after the open despite the 08:00 cutoff context.
Japanese semiconductor leaders fail to follow the U.S. technology lead after the open.
Long-term yields rise further and dominate the risk-on impulse.
